applicability.reason: The release governs untrusted repositories, filesystem writes, credentials, webhooks, workflow code, external integrations, and production automation.

summary: Adoption is deny-by-default, plan-digest bound, path-contained, non-overwriting, and project-memory preserving; n8n production eligibility requires least privilege, protected ingress, constrained nodes, retention, containment, and recovery.

checks.notes: Full preflight, target fingerprint, path containment, linked-path rejection, and exclusive creation are design requirements.
Risky nodes, unprotected webhooks, stale instances, environment separation, credentials, and production protection are governed.
No real n8n deployment or downstream production target is authorized.

findings.title: Downstream n8n security remains environment-specific
findings.required_action: Require fresh instance audit, node inventory, credential scope, webhook protection, egress, backup, restore, and incident evidence before downstream production activation.

evidence.summary: Approved trust boundaries and safe adoption failure behavior.
Official audit covers credentials, database expressions, filesystem access, risky/community/custom nodes, unprotected webhooks, settings, and version posture.
Official guidance describes Git-backed environments, protected production instances, and one-direction promotion patterns.

approval.reason: No external target, credential, deployment, or production action is in scope.

handoff: Close local negative tests before release; retain downstream production security as an explicit condition.
